blurb: Stone Cove Marina located in South Kingstown Rhode Island on scenic Pt. Judith Pond has offered a quiet, sheltered and convenient home for boaters since 1973. Our Southern Rhode Island location allows easy water access to Block Island, Newport or Narragansett Bay. Enjoy the Pond or just relax at the dock with family and friends.
